content: Juc runapita lutan espiritucunata Jesús gargongan
Chaypitam chrarärin chay gochra chimpan Gadara ninganman.
Jinarcurmi nä büquipita Jesús yargoyaptilan panteonpita yargor chraramun lutan espiritupa munayninchru cayag runa. Chay runaga yachranag panteoncunalachrümi.
Paytaga manash pisi cadenawan watarächiyta atipagchu.
Achca cutish watapäcura cadenacunawan maquintas chraquintas. Jinarcayaptinsi tipiypash usharug cadenacunataga. Chauraga nä manash pisi chay runata imanaytas atiparachu.
Nätan chay runaga pagaspas junagpas gapachracuyarshi purig, gotucunapas panteoncunapas rumicunawan chancacuyar.
Chaura Jesusta carupita ricapururga piryay piryarmi chraramun. Jinarcurmi, Jesuspa naupanman gongorpacuyun,
gapachracuypanuy cay niyar: “¿Imanarayanquitag nogawan, jana pachachru cayag Diospa-mayin Jesús? Diospa naupanchrümi manacuyag amar cunchuchimaychu”.
Chaynuypa lutan espirituga rimara, “Cay runapita yargoy” Jesús nä nisha captinmi.
Chaura Jesusga “¿Imatag jutiqui?” nirmi tapurun. Chaura lutan espirituga nirunmi: “Nogapa jutïga ‘Chraninmi sogta warangapita mascasca’ capäcuptï”.
Nircurga Jesustam manacurun alisca, chay Gadarapita mana jucläman gargonanpag.
Chauraga cayara achca cuchicunam micurcayar chay carcayangan tunapa.
Jinarcurmi chay lutan espiritucunaga manacarärin cay nir: “Wac cuchicunaman yaycapäcunäpag niyärimay”.

Chaura Jesús “Äri” niruptinga, chay lutan espiritucunaga runapita yargorcur cuchicunamanmi yaycarärin. Chay cuchicuna capäcura ishcay waranganuymi. Jinarcurmi löcu ricacarärir waraupa jegarparärin gochraman. Chaychrümi shengaypa wanurärin lapan.
Chaynuypa cuchicuna wanuräriptinga, cuchi michig runacunaga manchacasham gueshpicurcan, pitas maytas willapacurcayar marcacama. Chaura runacunaga juclam aywarärimun ricag.
Nä Jesús cayanganman chrarärirga lutan espiritucuna chay löcuchingan runataga tarirärin nä fisyun chrämushatam, jinaman jacusha tayayagtam. Chaynuyta ricarur runacunaga aliscam manchacarärin.
Nätan chay aywamusha runacunataga, chay ricagcunam willaparärin, chay runapita imanuypa lutan espiritucuna yargongantas jinaman cuchicunapitas.
Chaypitam chay runacunaga Jesusta cay nirärin: “Cay marcäcunapitanar jucläta aywacuy”.
Chaura Jesús nä “Äri” nir büquiman jegayaptinmi, chay cuticächingan runaga “Aywashunnar nogawansi” nirun.

Niptin Jesusga manam munarachu. Antis cay nirunmi: “Wayiquita castaycunaman aywacuy. Paycunata willapämuy lapanta Munayniyog Dios alisca cuyapäshurlay munayninwan lutan espiritucunata gampita yargonganta”.
Niptin chay runaga aywacunmi. Chaypitam galayurun willapacuyta Decápolis ningan marcacunapa Jesús paypita lutan espiritucunata gargonganta. Nätan mayagcunaga lapansi mayacasha niragmi ricacarärira.
Jairopa churinta cuticächig aywar, juc warmitas Jesús cuticächingan
Chaypitam caylä chimpaman nä büquiwan Jesús cutiramuptinga, paycagman chranin runacuna gotucarärimun, nätan payga nä cayara gochra manyanchrümi.
Chaymanmi chraramun Jairo jutiyog runa. Payga cara Israel castacuna gotucurcänan wayichru mandagcuna castam. Jinarcurmi chay runaga Jesusta ricaparurga naupanman aywarcur gongorpacuyun.
Chaypitam manacura alisca cay nir: “Wariwamrämi nä wanunayan. Aywaläshunnar yatayuruptiqui cuticarurga cawanangam”.
Chaura Jesusga aywacun Jairowanmi. Chay aywaptinmi chranin runacuna guepanta aywapäcura chumi chumi.
Chay runacunachrümi aywanag juc gueshyag warmis. Payga nä gueshyanag chrunca ishcayniyog watam yawar apaywan.

Chay gueshyawan mana ali carshi, achca jampicugcunachru purira jampichicuyta. Jinayälarshi lapan ima-aygantas usharura. Nätan manash maygalansi cuticächirachüga, antis waranpa waranpash masta chruracayara.
Payga aywaramunag Jesuspita rimagta mayarshi. Jinarcurshi Jesuspa guepanman yaycura runacuna chraupinpa, Jesuspa jacunta yatayunanpag,
shongolanchru cay niyar: “Jacunta tupayularsi cuticäshagmi” nir.
Chay ningannuylash yatayuruptinga chayüra yawarga illacarura. Chauraga chaylash mayacurun nä cuticasha cayanganta.
Chayüram Jesussi tantiarun munayninwan juc runa cuticächinganta. Jinarcurmi runacunaman muyurcamurga tapurun: “¿Pitag jacüta tuparaman?” nir.
Niptinmi discïpuluncunaga cay nirärin: “Chumi chumi aywayashachu, ‘¿Pitag tuparaman?’ niyanqui”.
Chaura Jesusga chay muyurigninchru cayag runacunatam rircapayta galacuyun pi tupangantas musyananpag.
Chaura warmiga cuticasha canganta nä musyarga, manchacasham chucchucyayar, Jesuspa naupanman gongorpacuyur willacurun tupayular cuticanganta.
Chaura Jesusga nirunmi: “Wamralä, cuticäshagmi nir yupachicamarmi cuticarunqui. Chaura cananga aywacuy cushisha”.
Chay niyaptilanmi Jairopa wayinpita cachramushacuna chrarärimun cay nir: “Yangam pushayanqui yachrachigtaga. Wamrayga nämi wanurun”.
Chay nigta mayarurmi Jesusga Jairota cay nin: “Ama manchacaychu. Yupayla yupachicamayga”.
Chaura Jesusga Jairopa wayinta aywarga pusharicura Pedrotam, nätan ishcay wauguelatam Jacobotawan Juanta. Chaypitacagtaga manam munarachu pi aywanantas.
Nä Jairopa wayinman chrarurga, tarirun wamra wanushapita gapachracuypa äyay äyar wagarcayagtam.
Chaura Jesusga wayiman yaycurcurmi cay nirun: “¿Imanirtag chaynuypa wagarcayanqui? Wamraga punucashalam cayan. Manam wanushachu”.
Niptinmi runacunaga asiparärin. Chaura Jesusga wayipitam gargorun lapanta. Chaypitam yaycurun chay wanusha wamra cayanganman quima discïpuluncunalawan, jinaman wamrapa taytanwan mamanwan.
Chauraga wamrapa maquinta chariyurmi arameo rimaychru cay nin: “Talita, cumi”. (‘Talita, cumi’ ninanga ‘Wamra, ¡sharcuy!’ ninanmi.)
Niptin wamraga chayüram sharcurcur puriyta galacuyun. Chay wamra cara chrunca ishcayniyog watayogmi. Chaura chaynuy ruragta ricarärir runacunaga mayacasha niragmi ricacarärin.
Chaypitam Jesusga chruncay chruncay nira mana pitas willapacurcänanpag, jinamanmi nira wamrata micuyta garapäcunanpag.
